causal.assumptions_right: The hike path (CORRA 2.30 vs Mar27 3.125) and the oil inflation impulse remain on the tape.
causal.assumptions_wrong_or_underweighted: Competition rank and book marks can gap without the live implied retracing the policy path; Iran-deal oil is an inflation impulse, not a clean risk-on FX impulse.
causal.causal_divergence: Rank 4 to 8 was competition and mark variance, not an 82bp collapse of the priced CAD hike path.
causal.future_implication: Keep the live pay while 2.30 versus 3.125 and the oil bid hold; do not add into a recovered rank, and do not close solely because rank previously shocked.
causal.observed_reality: Mar27 implieds only slipped 3.13 to 3.125; oil is still bid at 105.28/92.60; the rank and book shock was far larger than the live instrument move and has already mean-reverted.
causal.original_belief: Paying CAD March 2027 implieds expresses resilient growth and an oil-supported BoC tightening path.
causal.same_information_counterfactual: Closing or cutting on the rank-8 print with Mar27 still at 3.125 and crude still bid would have treated leaderboard noise as policy-path information and would have missed the subsequent recovery.

items.what_happened_vs_expected: The CAD implieds pay was expected to track a still-priced BoC hike path, not a leaderboard crash. At trigger, rank fell 4 to 8 with a drawdown of 15107.64 and net result of -5321.52, but frozen Mar27 CORRA only moved 3.13 to 3.125 while spot CORRA 2.30 versus 3.125 still priced tightening. Rank has since recovered to 4 and the shock was mark-to-market and competition variance around an intact rates thesis, not a broken growth/oil-into-BoC story.
